title: Shinonome Akito — Brand New Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: One day, during lunch
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Those two never change...
Don't they ever run out of things to talk about during lunch?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I mean, they are partners.
I'm guessing they can talk about anything.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is that how that works...?
The next day - Lunch break

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, would you like to get lunch?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: We're second-years now, but this still plays out the same.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Hang on. Don't tell me you're not friends with anyone in your own class.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Then what am I supposed to call you guys? But I'll be happy to leave if that's what you want.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Wait, what?!
I thought we were besties!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Fine, leave. We didn't want you anyway.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Toya, as a former classmate, here's a friendly piece of advice. You're a socially awkward guy, so you should be talking with people from your own class more than someone like Akito here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, but I should be fine.
I've been able to put into practice all my experiences with you from last year.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Aw, shucks, that's a nice thing to say about us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, let's go.
A few days later - Lunch break
Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya, you there?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
He is indeed♪
You guys really are inseparable.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You decided to show up today...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: To be fair, I just got here a second ago!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, Toya and I were just having a friendly chat as classmates♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! You look totally disinterested.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I doubt Akito would be all that interested in talking about books with us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Books? Like novels?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. We were just discussing the story that this one anime Akiyama likes is based on.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Apparently, the creator of the source material for this anime I'm hooked on lately was really influenced by mystery novels!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And both the original and the show have all these little nods to the genre scattered throughout it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which is why I decided to ask Toya about it since he likes mystery novels.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ah, still no interest, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't read novels or watch much anime...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Personally, I'm surprised to hear that, considering you were born in the home of anime.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, we gotta get to the school store before they run out of the good stuff.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So, you got any plans...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? For what?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: For lunch. Did you eat already?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No. I didn't eat anything because I thought I'd make it in time for lunch.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I'd rather not ruin you guys' fun.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, then, have fun eating alone.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, wait! I'm sorry!
That was a joke!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let me have lunch with you guys! Please!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You couldn't just say that right away?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Li'l Bro, your buttons are just too much fun to press♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's it. We're going without you...
